description: Western Province - Summoned the Western Province Provincial Council to meet on 31.12.2015 in order to reconsider the Appropriation Statute No. 04 of 2015 for the Financial Statement for 2016
reasoning: This gazette content announces the summoning of the Western Province Provincial Council to reconsider an appropriation statute. This falls under electoral and governmental process matters, specifically the scheduling and convening of a legislative body session, which aligns with Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) covering "Election announcements and schedules" and related governmental assembly proceedings.
